description: Temporal email layer (ee/temporal-workflows/src/services/email-service.ts) delegates real sends to the shared packages/email provider; the throwing ProductionEmailService SMTP/SES/SendGrid stubs are removed
createEmailService() resolves an SMTP-capable provider without ever throwing 'not implemented'
System + Temporal sends resolve the tenant-configured SMTP provider (the Outbound Email screen's providerConfigs), with env (EMAIL_*) fallback used only for pre-onboarding/system mail
sendWelcomeEmail activity sends via the resolved SMTP provider (no silent no-op, no crash); cleanly falls back/no-ops when no provider is configured yet
temporal-worker startup validation no longer hard-fails when email is SMTP-configured and RESEND_API_KEY is absent
temporal-worker image builds successfully with the packages/email dependency across the ESM/CJS boundary (validated against the Argo-built image, not just Dockerfile.build)
Appliance ships EMAIL_PROVIDER_TYPE=smtp as the explicit default so Resend is never auto-detected on the appliance

In appliance/self-host mode the system email path (SystemEmailProviderFactory / TenantEmailService) resolves the single tenant's enabled SMTP providerConfig, with env fallback, so the Outbound Email screen is the single source of truth
SystemEmailProviderFactory missing-config error messages reference SMTP variables (EMAIL_HOST/USERNAME/PASSWORD), never Resend, on the appliance
Appliance status surface shows 'Email: configured/unconfigured' based on the resolved provider
Regression-pin: the existing Communications > Outbound Email screen persists SMTP config and that config actually drives tenant business email on the appliance
alga-core has a stable in-cluster endpoint (Service or matching targetPort) reachable by the email-service pod for IMAP webhook POSTs despite hostNetwork
Appliance email-service single-node values set webhook.url to that endpoint; IMAP_WEBHOOK_URL is emitted into the pod env (never falls back to http://server:3000)
emailService.resolveWebhookUrl fails loudly with a clear message when no webhook URL is configured instead of silently using the server:3000 fallback
IMAP_WEBHOOK_SECRET is shared/consistent between the email-service and alga-core on the appliance so inbound webhook auth succeeds end-to-end

Documentation for single-host vanity portal: customer LB+cert+DNS pointing the vanity domain at the appliance and setting NEXTAUTH_URL/--app-url to it, using existing code (no Istio/cert-manager/GitOps)
An admin action/CLI/seed marks a portal_domains row active for the single tenant by calling the existing upsertPortalDomain with status:'active', bypassing the Temporal workflow
On the appliance the client-portal domain-settings UI uses the mark-active path instead of enqueuing the cloud provisioning workflow
Documentation for multi-host: LB routes both the MSP host and a separate vanity client-portal host to the app; PORTAL_DOMAIN_DNS_CHECK=false documented
The cloud-only portal-domain provisioning workflow (Istio/cert-manager/GitOps) is never enqueued on the appliance (no inert failing runs)
Managed email-domain (SPF/DKIM) settings UI is hidden in appliance mode
managedDomainActions are unreachable/short-circuit in appliance mode rather than throwing 'requires RESEND_API_KEY' to the operator
Documentation states appliance SMTP-relay sending does not require managed-domain (SPF/DKIM) verification; the relay/provider handles deliverability
A single reliable 'appliance/self-host mode' predicate exists and is used consistently for UI/feature gating
A connected-appliance license check-in job/task POSTs appliance_credential to the stored check_in_url on a schedule
The alga-license refresh/check-in endpoint contract (request/response shape + auth) is confirmed or stood up so the check-in has a real server to call
The refreshed JWT from check-in is verified against the baked-in public key before being stored
A successful check-in updates the appliance-license-seed Secret and the license_state row atomically; tier reflects the new token
Check-in failures retry with backoff and are surfaced without crashing the app; airgap appliances (no check_in_url) skip check-in cleanly
License UI shows tier, exp, and (connected) last-check-in time with a manual 'refresh now' action
Pre-expiry warning is shown in the License/status UI when the JWT is approaching exp
Documentation states the appliance requires a one-time HTTPS reach to license.nineminds.com/register at install; a fully offline install is an explicit non-goal
Documented egress allowlist (license.nineminds.com, ghcr.io + container-registry hosts) for appliance install and updates
Setup/preflight surfaces reachability checks for license.nineminds.com and ghcr.io with actionable errors
Documentation records that the *.svc.cluster.local code defaults are appliance-overridden to the msp namespace and must be set explicitly for any non-appliance deploy
Documented inventory of cloud-only surfaces shipped-but-inert on the appliance (nm-store middleware, billing webhooks, Stripe distribution)
Tests pin that nm-store-protected and billing-webhook routes are inert/fail-closed in appliance mode
Test pins that isLicenseDistributionTenant() fails closed (Stripe distribution hidden) on the appliance
End-to-end: a fresh appliance configured with only an SMTP relay sends (system + tenant + Temporal) and receives IMAP email with zero Resend connectivity
All changes validated on the real Argo-built appliance image via a libvirt VM install (nightly channel) before promotion to stable
release.json / channels pin the validated image once the on-prem fixes pass VM validation
